title.narrative: Preparatory Study of the IIMC Youth Council

description.narrative: On this preparatory study trip, members of IMCC Indien plan to spend eight days in Kolkata, India, where they will further explore the possibility of conducting a pilot project with an organised group of young volunteers in the Youth Council of Indian Institute of Mother and Child (IIMC). Our common goal is to create a space for young graduates from the IIMC schools to gather around shared interests, fostering new friendships and acquiring skills that will aid them in entering the job market and actively participating in democracy. We aim to collaborate on establishing common structures for the Youth Council's future work. Given that youth involvement is new to most participants in the Youth Council, it is crucial for us to create an open and safe environment for idea generation and equal discussions.
